A Laboratory That Turns Requests into Experiments | Nature

An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations
First author: Wu, Mingyu
Last author: Chen, Haibo
Co-first authors: Mingyu Wu, Zhaoguo Wang, Jiabin Wang
Journal: Nature
Published online: 2026-11-04
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6

AutoDNA connects AI planning with robotic laboratory equipment to carry out complex DNA tasks, improve experimental performance and coordinate shared instruments. Demonstrations spanning DNA data storage and mutation detection show how integrated laboratories could make sophisticated biomolecular experiments more accessible.
